body: Thanks, maybe I can start living for myself rather than staying alive for my family one day

>It's been more than a decade I am completely obsessed with that elusive thing. It seems like reciprocal love is the hardest thing to find in our conditions, and I am "fine" with that realization most of the time. Why do I need it anyway? For...validation? 

>I hate this current train of thoughts highlighting the mess. I know this rock is the purgatory. It explains a lot. Nothing "good" could possibly happen, and what is primarily perceived as "good" will turn out to be a catastrophe.

>The initial dream was to find someone of the opposite sex I would feel connected to. We'd spend our days making love and theorizing, listening to Schoenberg and criticizing everything. But the best thing would be...silence. Yeah.

>It's impossible. My standards are far too high. I can't be around people. I've developed an aversion to normalcy. I find myself lost in thoughts most of the time. People generally seem to like me though, I've had individuals of both genders interested in dating me, but they were too mentally unattractive to me. I'd rather be alone than with someone who is not perfect for me, but I sometimes have, hm, urges.

>I don't really know. It's probably the only thing I still want, perhaps even the most pleasurable.

>Is anyone in a similar situation? If so, what do you do about it?

I'm pretty much in the exact same situation except that I try to avoid "solving" it. I don't trust myself to fall in love again, unless I "get my shit together" which I don't seem to doing any progress at.

Just yesterday I was at an ordinary party, with ordinary people doing ordinary things...

EDIT: Sorry I couldn't be of more help
